payload.title: feat/goal-end 0ebffbc: the end as an answer's ends item, ended derived, writes under it refused
payload.body: Commit 0ebffbc5fe63117a046b28253fca3351b27b59ec on feat/goal-end, over base main. An answer's ends item, keyed by a Goal id, ends the Goal in its adder's words; replay rejects other actors, a second end and a mixed answer; the Goal reads ended; Owed and turns skip it; the CLI refuses writes under it; hyp prompt refuses it; cites read ended. ADR 0023, spec, glossary, principles and the owner-answer and owner-grill skills change with it.

why: OWED owes rivals on Q-MW23YW; this is the first commit of the build
the Hypothesis's subject is its commit

payload.title: Gate of 0ebffbc: new tests red on base and green, removals, vet/test, review, skill review
payload.body:
Gate of h-end-1 (commit 0ebffbc). Aims at lines 1-9.
Tests: internal/cli/goal_end_test.go. On base 8cd0c6e: red for lines 1-7 (TestEndOfAGoalInProgress, TestEndOfACompleteGoal L1; TestEndByAnotherActor* L2, replay rejects for the rule's own reason; TestSecondOrMixedEnd* L3; TestEndedGoalShowsNothingThatWaits L4; TestWriteUnderAnEndedGoal* L5; TestPromptForAnEndedGoalRefused L6; TestEndedGoalIsCited L7); green TestGoalNotEndedRefusedAsACite (L7 last sentence, holds on base). Each must be green on the commit.
Lines 8, 9 (skill prose) by reading: on base owner-answer names no --end, and the grill read-back sends never-settled kinds to the owner and needs a rerun with none unplaced. On the commit each line's words must hold in the skill text, and ak-skill-creator update, audit and optimize review of the changed skills must find no defect that is a case of line 8 or 9.
Removal checks, each a patch that must apply whole, else a failed removal: the actor rule (L2 tests fail), the already-ended rule and the mixed rule (L3), the write refusal at run and admission (L5), the prompt refusal (L6), the ended cite (L7), the Owed skip (L4).
go vet ./... and go test ./... -count=1 green.
Review: a fresh subagent reads git show 0ebffbc against the Goal and its lines, returns each finding as a test with its output on the commit, run in a checkout of 0ebffbc off the run branch, labelled with its line or none. A returned test that is a case of a line and red on the commit contradicts h-end-1.
Verdict: supports when every test above is green on the commit, every removal bites, the skill review finds no line-8/9 defect and no review test that is a case of a line is red; contradicts when one is red; a red finding whose line placement is in doubt makes it inconclusive with a reading.

why: the gate of h-end-1, pre-registered before it runs

payload.observation: On 0ebffbc5fe63117a046b28253fca3351b27b59ec: go vet and go test green; the 12 new tests red on base for lines 1-7 and green on the commit, line 7's last sentence green on both; all 7 removals bite; the skill review finds every clause of lines 8 and 9 in the text. The code review returned 6 tests: 4 green, 2 red, each a case at the edge of its line (line 4: a referred line's hand under LINES; line 7: which Goal is 'its Goal'). Those two are the only failures, so the verdict waits on the two readings.
readings: G-K0AXM0#4: "shows nothing that waits" has two meanings. Meaning 1: nothing waits in the places the line lists: OWED, AWAITING OWNER, the waits lines of its questions, and the GOALS row. Meaning 2: no word anywhere in hyp status asks the owner to act, also the LINES row of a referred line ("referred: the owner accepts or returns it"). This run used meaning 1. TestReviewEndedGoalReferredLineStillAsksTheOwner tests meaning 2; h-end-1 fails it. Question: does line 4 cover a word on a row outside the places it lists, such as the hand of a referred line under LINES?

G-K0AXM0#7: "A line written before the end prints that its Goal has since ended" has two meanings. Meaning 1: "its Goal" is the Goal of the cited key: a line of another Goal that cites a key of G, written before the end of G, prints that G has since ended. Meaning 2: "its Goal" is the line's own Goal: hyp show of a line of the ended Goal G prints that G has since ended. This run used meaning 1. TestReviewOwnLineOfAnEndedGoalPrintsTheEnd tests meaning 2; h-end-1 fails it. Question: which Goal is "its Goal" in this sentence?

why: the gate and review of h-end-1 ran as E-RK24KG pre-registered; its only red cases are in doubt
